respuesta.pregunta: How do I turn on debug logging, and how should I send a test request so I can see the full exchange?
respuesta.respuesta:
You turn on debug logging in `log4j2.xml` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L113-L113]. The documented configuration sets the `com.zaxxer.hikari` and `org.apache.http` loggers to `level="DEBUG"` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L117-L118].

For a test request with verbose output, the guide uses `curl -v` against a brand on the local service: `curl -v "http://localhost:8080/catalog/brands/123"` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L140-L141]. To test authentication, it sends the `X-Client-Id` header: `curl -H "X-Client-Id: test" "http://localhost:8080/catalog/brands/"` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L146-L147].

respuesta.historial_usuario: Hi! I'm working with catalog-portfolio-api version 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a locally. A few brands won't activate and some requests feel slow, so I'm trying to debug what's going on.
respuesta.historial_asistente: Happy to help with that. What would you like to look at first?
respuesta.pregunta: Can I check straight in the database whether a brand exists and how many logos it has? And how do I measure how long a request to the brands endpoint takes?
respuesta.respuesta:
Yes. The troubleshooting guide has SQL queries for this. To check that a brand exists, query the `brand` table by id: `SELECT * FROM brand WHERE id = 123;` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L124-L125]. To count its logos, join `brand` with `logo` on `brand_id`:

```sql
SELECT b.name, COUNT(l.id) as logo_count
FROM brand b
LEFT JOIN logo l ON b.id = l.brand_id
WHERE b.id = 123;
```
[catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L130-L134]

Replace `123` with your brand's id. The guide also shows how to list brands that are still in `STAND_BY`: `SELECT name, status, date_created FROM brand WHERE status = 'STAND_BY';` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L127-L128].

To time a request, use curl's `-w` option with a format file: `curl -w "@curl-format.txt" "http://localhost:8080/catalog/brands/"` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L143-L144]. The guide doesn't show what goes inside `curl-format.txt`.
